featured_reviews.name: Rafiya farheen
featured_reviews.review_text:
I took this PG for one month, but unfortunately I had to leave within just 3 days due to serious issues.
Firstly, the PG is not organized or properly managed by the owner, Mansi. There is no hygiene maintained. The washroom and washbasin are extremely dirty and unclean. The kitchen is not properly accessible — only a few people are allowed to use it, while others are restricted. You cannot cook properly.
This is the month of Ramzan, and when I raised concerns regarding basic facilities, my complaints were ignored. The warden clearly refused washing clothes saying, “If I get time, I will do,” which is very unprofessional. There is also theft happening — many residents’ belongings are going missing.
Most importantly, there is no proper space or freedom to offer namaz peacefully. When I complained about these issues, the warden behaved rudely and misbehaved. After the owner Mansi leaves, arguments continue till 2 AM, disturbing everyone and that cause me a mental Harrasement.
The warden is a 19-year-old girl from Nepal who does not understand our language properly and is not capable of managing the PG responsibly.
There is a prepaid system — if you pay for one full month, there is strictly no refund under any circumstances. Even though the facilities and commitments promised on the first day were not fulfilled, they refused to consider any refund.
Because of all this, I lost my full amount of ₹6,000 within just 3 days.
Overall, it was a very stressful and disappointing experience. Basic hygiene, proper management, safety, and respect for residents are completely lacking.

Friends,

Do not waste ur money here. I am describing u the horrible situations in details here.-

2. Aqua guard is defective- it is more than 4 years old. But still its filter was not replaced. So we have to buy drinking water. Additional cost of Rs 600/month.
3. Mobile Network not available- there is no network available of any service provider in India. U have to walk  only 400m to dial a single call.

4. There is only 1 kitchen for more than 15 people so after returning office or college if u planned to cook u will not get it bcz alreday some one is cooking and another 1 or 2 people is waiting in line.and there is lot of rats in the kitchen.
4. In most of the toilets either toilet spray or shower is not working.
5. Rooms are too much congested. Owner has not left one inch space. In the two peoples room he added 3 beds.  U can not walk properly in ur room.
6. Agreement- in last 3 months  whenever I called him for the paper everytime land lord said he is in meeting.no matter what is the time even it is 10pm. With confidence he will lie alot when u will met him physically.he will tell u no of stories of his busy life.
7. Wifi- speed 40kbps. And some times taht is also not available. Landlord is saying he will call wifi person to repair.

Ultimately he will not give u any paper. But he needs everything on thr time. He needs advance immidiately.He needs rent without 1 days delay. But u can not ask any service.

Most of all what the advance u will deposit that will totally be in ur risk bcz there is no documents with u later if he deny. And u have to beg at his door for releasing the amount after leaving the room.

It is clear that owner is just here to grab ur money. Once u give him the money, u have to cry rest of the period.

So, personal advice. Keep 5km safe distance from this PG. Don't even think to try this one.
